prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless square PBR base-color source texture for the interior wall and door panels of a realistic Roblox elevator cabin.
Primary request: an orthographic flat material scan of pristine light cool gray brushed stainless steel. Smooth fine horizontal parallel brushed grain across the entire image, extremely fine shallow machining lines, moderate satin finish.
Composition/framing: surface only, edge-to-edge flat square texture, no cabin geometry or visible borders. Truly seamless left/right and top/bottom for tiling.
Lighting: uniform flat diffuse illumination for an albedo map, no directional highlights, no shadows, no gradients, no reflected scene.
Color palette: very light neutral cool gray, average RGB around 190, 192, 194; subtle grain tonal range, no warm cast.
Constraints: continuous fine horizontal grain; realistic clean new elevator stainless steel; retain a smooth gray overall appearance at a distance. No rust, corrosion, scratches, dents, dirt, patina, streaking, blotches, seams, bevels, rivets, logos, text, watermark, brown, bronze, gold, or dramatic reflections. Opaque background.
notes: Original generated image copied unchanged; clean horizontal light cool gray brushed stainless steel source for elevator only.
